Consumers' five-to-ten-year inflation outlook remained anchored at 3.3%, unchanged for the third consecutive month. Only 8% of consumers expect their income growth to outpace inflation in the year ahead, down from 18% in December 2024. [...] The decline was broad-based. While views of personal finances saw only minor changes, expected business conditions sank 11% for the short run and 17% for the long run, according to the survey.
